title: PROVERBS 4:18
THE PATH OF THE JUST
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: golden sun rays through morning mist forest
sunrise light glowing on mountain peaks
morning dew drops on green grass illuminated by sun
soft sunrise light through window blinds in quiet room
bright morning horizon with golden light breaking through clouds
sunlight illuminating a quiet forest path at dawn
golden hour light over a serene misty lake

scenes.a: That heavy fog of confusion rolling into your room right now will not have the final word.
Listen to the wisdom given to us in Proverbs 4:18.
The path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, shining ever brighter unto the full day.
Father, as this new light touches the earth, touch our hearts and steady our footing.
Clear away the shadows of doubt that try to make us stumble in the dark.
Help us to walk forward today with quiet confidence in your steadfast grace.
Let your gentle truth lead us step by step into the morning. Amen.
